correctness.rationale: For d>=2 and invertible A, F_A=A circ P_d is finite surjective. Luo--Meng (arXiv:2610.10103v1, Section 1) gives linearity of any irreducible totally invariant V. V=preimage under P_d of A^{-1}V, so every coordinate d-th-root symmetry fixes V. Subtracting a root-scaled vector from the original isolates each coordinate axis, proving V is coordinate. Surjectivity gives A(L_I)=L_I, equivalently the exact block-zero criterion; the converse follows from P_d^{-1}(L_I)=L_I. Reachability closure, condensation upper sets, parameter-locus codimensions and distributive-lattice realization follow by explicit graph theory and triangular invertible matrices. The accompanying verify.py was run and returned VERIFY_OK for all invertible binary support matrices of size 2,3,4; this finite check does not prove the general theorem.

value.rationale: This is a motivated complete classification for the natural matrix-mixed coordinate-power family prompted by the new general linearity theorem. It determines exactly which irreducible exceptional varieties occur, all incidence relations and their count, and the irreducible components and precise codimensions of the parameter loci where a given dimension occurs. It shows every finite distributive lattice can arise as the exceptional incidence lattice, so the family exhibits a universal combinatorial spectrum. These are structural all-dimension statements, not a single numerical example, and go beyond the previously known sharp cardinality bounds. The claims are restricted to the first inverse image and irreducible varieties.
